cues.k510-001: Welcome aboard, explorers. I'm the Commander. We're setting off to answer a question people have asked ever since they first looked at the sky: are we alone?
cues.k510-002: Long ago, they say, humanity had a star of its very own. One night, it broke into pieces that scattered across three worlds. No one has seen it since.
cues.k510-003: We're bringing it home. And don't worry: star pieces won't burn or cut you. They're soft, like morning light.
cues.k510-004: A uses the left half of the tablet, B the right. Each of you has your own patch of sky.
cues.k510-005: You can join in, or just watch. I'll stay with you either way. That's how great things begin: with everyone aboard.
cues.k510-006: Our star is somewhere ahead. Look at the sky, and hold on tight. Here we go!
cues.k510-007: We're leaving Earth behind. I'll remember the way back. That's my job. Yours is to remember that blue.
cues.star-r13a: Look at Earth. Everyone you know is down there.
cues.k510-008: So many lights! Even pockets as big as our ship couldn't hold them all. But we aren't looking for every star. Just one.
cues.star-r14a: The first world. Its people have no bodies like ours. They are made of light, and speak through it. Here, words aren't translated. They're felt.
cues.star-r14b: Here, those who love shine. Those who understand become a beacon for others. We see you from far away, travellers. What a lovely glow you have.
cues.k510-009: Welcome to Siwarha. Pieces of your star fell here long ago. We kept them among our own. You don't throw light away.
cues.k510-010: Look at the large shape at the top. Tap the piece that matches it. Take your time: the light has waited a thousand years. It can wait another minute.
cues.k510-011: You don't need to put your pieces anywhere. They come to the ship by themselves, and fly beside us. Look!
cues.k510-012-C: All the pieces are flying beside you now. They've found one another again. Thousands of years apart, and they still remember.
cues.k510-012-P: The pieces you found are flying beside the ship. The others will keep lighting Siwarha. No light is lost. Only borrowed.
cues.k510-012-Z: Didn't take anything? Then here's a circle of light to fly with you. On Siwarha, no guest leaves in the dark.
cues.k510-013: Thank you, Siwarha. Our ship has never had an escort of lights before. Next comes the workshop where the pieces find their place.
cues.star-r21a: The second world looks like ours, but it isn't. Here, the planet thinks. Roots are its nerves, rivers its blood. When the wind blows, the forest talks to itself.
cues.star-r21b: Here, no one is alone. It's impossible. When a tree hurts, the whole forest knows. When a river laughs, the sea laughs too.
cues.k510-014: Come into the workshop. Every piece belongs somewhere, like a seed in the soil. If you're missing one, I'll give you one from my garden. That's what gardens are for.
cues.k510-015: Place the piece inside its outline. Drag it, or tap the piece and then its place. Every shape knows where home is. Just help it get there.
cues.k510-016: Each window has two spaces. The pieces stay whole, side by side. Just like you. Nothing shines alone.
cues.k510-017-C: The windows are ready. Every piece in its place, and every place glad to have it. Your star is taking shape.
cues.k510-017-P: The pieces you placed will stay there. There are empty spaces too. That's where the light gets through. Even a gap can be useful.
cues.k510-017-Z: I'm sending a leaf from my garden to fly with you. A leaf remembers the sun.
cues.k510-018: The star has a body and windows. It needs light inside. You can't find that light or put it in place. You have to switch it on. Let's keep going.
cues.star-r28a: The third world is made of crystal. Its people have overcome illness and distance. They know everything. Calculate everything. Nothing has amazed them in a million years.
cues.star-r28b: Welcome. Nothing surprises us any more. Nothing hurts us. That's why we like visitors. You still feel wonder. Here, that's become rare.
cues.k510-019: Mann's workshop, at your service! We repair stars, umbrellas... sometimes even shadows. Just in time: a darkness we never calculated is gathering outside.
cues.k510-020: Your tablet shows a battery, a bulb and two connectors. Turn the connectors until the wires meet. When the path is complete, the bulb lights up.
cues.k510-021: Follow the wire from the battery, through the bulb, and back. A break in the path? Turn again. The wire is patient. The darkness, a little less so. Let's get to work!
cues.k510-022-C: Circuits closed. The star is shining! Take a good look, darkness. We who know everything didn't make this light. They did. The ones who still feel wonder.
cues.k510-022-P: Your connections will stay in place. I'll solder the rest. That's what a craftsperson does. The star is shining, and it's coming with you.
cues.k510-022-Z: The wires are still on the table? I'll connect them, with a spark from the workshop. But tell everyone at home: that spark came from us!
cues.star-r34a: A question for the journey, travellers. If nothing amazes you and nothing hurts you, what stays alive inside you? Don't answer me. Take the question home.
cues.k510-023: A shining star with a travelling tail. Now it's a comet. And it's ours. I'll keep it beside me: in the darkness, it'll see first.
cues.k510-024: We're entering the star tunnel. The tablets can rest. They've done their job. Now our comet will guide us. You lit it just in time.
cues.k510-025: Stars flow past us like a river. You can follow our comet or watch the whole sky. From here, every road leads home.
cues.v4-saturn-01: The rings! It's Saturn. We're back in the Solar System, close to home. I know the way from here with my eyes closed.
cues.v4-saturn-02: From far away, the rings look whole. Up close, countless pieces of ice and rock. Like our star. Like everything that lasts: many pieces, one light.
cues.v4-saturn-03: Goodbye, Saturn. Next comes a world with oceans and clouds, and people waiting for us at the window.
cues.star-r40a: We've seen three worlds. One of light. One alive, like a single soul. One of crystal. Now look at the fourth.
cues.k510-026: Earth! Look how blue it is. We left in the dark. And look at the company we're bringing home.
cues.k510-027: Look at the night side. City lights are coming on, one by one. Millions of little lights.
cues.star-r42a: Humanity's star was never lost. It just isn't in the sky. It's in people, one light beside another.
cues.k510-028: And our piece is home again. I'll put it in the window. Perhaps someone down there can see it right now. And feel wonder.
cues.k510-029: When you look at the sky, travellers, don't search up there for your star. Look for it in one another. That's where we put it.
cues.k510-030: Our journey is over. The screen shows the star and our path through three worlds. Every light there was touched by someone's hand.
cues.k510-031-C: Here are the pieces you found, the windows you built, the wires you connected. This is Humanity's Star. Your part of it.
cues.k510-031-P: Here are your contributions, and the gifts the worlds added. A star made together. Like every star that lasts.
cues.k510-031-Z: Here's the star we received along the way: a circle, a leaf, a spark and a comet's tail. We'll keep it as a memory. After all, memories are light too.
cues.k510-032: The tablets can rest. Watch the star, or whisper to your neighbour. There's just one gift left to choose. The most important one.
cues.k510-033: The star stays where we can see it. It belongs among people. You're coming home, with something new inside you. Welcome home, crew!
cues.k510-034: Stay at your stations. Your guide will tell you when and where to go. The star will keep watch.
